title: Principal twistor models and asymptotic hyperkähler metrics
summary: Let $X$ be a conical symplectic variety admitting a crepant resolution $Y$. Based on the theory of universal Poisson deformations, we construct a complex manifold called the principal twistor model associated with $Y$. We prove a universality theorem for this model: if the regular locus of $X$ admits an algebraic hyperkähler cone metric $g_0$, then the twistor space of any algebraic hyperkähler metric on $Y$ asymptotic to $g_0$ is uniquely recovered by slicing the principal twistor model.
